title: 海纜登陸工程
summary: 把海纜由近岸水下轉至陸域的資料基準、曲率和環境限制連接成完整交接圖。 在海纜登陸介面與地形室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Connect underwater-to-land datums, curvature and environmental constraints in a cable-landfall handoff map. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Cable-landfall interface/terrain studio. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 海陸圖資尺度一致性：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Marine/land map scale consistency: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 海陸圖資尺度一致性 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Marine/land map scale consistency and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「海纜登陸工程」的「海陸圖資尺度一致性」中，定位誤差與海圖基準、比例尺和水深資料品質是不同來源。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：把海纜由近岸水下轉至陸域的資料基準、曲率和環境限制連接成完整交接圖。
steps.instructionEn: Within Submarine-cable landfall engineering, Marine/land map scale consistency examines this mechanism: Position uncertainty, chart datum, scale and depth quality are distinct error sources. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Connect underwater-to-land datums, curvature and environmental constraints in a cable-landfall handoff map.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：圖上距離20 mm，比例尺1:50000。關係式 d=map×scale；含單位換算算式 20*50000/1000 = 1000 m。適用條件：純比例尺練習，不是航線規劃或避碰指示。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Chart distance 20 mm at scale 1:50000. Relation d=map×scale; expression including unit conversion 20*50000/1000 = 1000 m. Applicability: Scale exercise only, not route planning or collision avoidance.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：放大顯示不會增加原始測深精度。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Display zoom does not increase source sounding accuracy. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「海陸圖資尺度一致性」，比較縮放前後資料解析度，讀取資料來源與更新時間。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「海纜登陸工程」的「海陸圖資尺度一致性：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海上能源：岸電交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Marine/land map scale consistency: Mechanism and observation” in “Submarine-cable landfall engineering”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Offshore Energy: Shore-Power Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.
